commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Mark O'Mahony (Brighton) picks up a yellow card.
90+6' Adam Lallana (Brighton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

90+6' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

90+4' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Brighton have a free kick.
90+3' Brighton are ruled offside.
90+3' Brighton earn a free kick. Josh Brownhill (Burnley) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Joel Veltman (Brighton) gets a yellow card for protesting.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Joao Pedro and he is replaced by Mark O'Mahony (Brighton).
86' Jacob Bruun Larsen goes off the pitch and Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) comes on.
85' A player from Burnley commits a rough challenge. Simon Hooper blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Brighton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
83' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Bart Verbruggen stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
79' 1 - 1 Arijanet Muric (Burnley) scores an own goal! No one would like to be in his position right now.
79' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
77' Adam Lallana (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Adingra.
77' Here is a change. Danny Welbeck is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
77' Substitution. Jakub Moder did his best and is replaced by Ansu Fati (Brighton).
77' Simon Hooper blows his whistle. Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) commits a foul after dangerous play.

74' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball breaks to Josh Brownhill (Burnley) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:0.
73' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bart Verbruggen, who smothers the ball.
73' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Danny Welbeck (Brighton) heads on.
72' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.
72' Lyle Foster (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
71' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
69' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Bart Verbruggen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
67' Craig Bellamy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josh Brownhill (Burnley) replacing Hjalmar Ekdal.
64' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Datro Fofana trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
60' Joao Pedro (Brighton) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
60' The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.

60' Pascal Gross (Brighton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Arijanet Muric easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
59' A cross into the box from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared.
59' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared by the defence.
58' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Pascal Gross (Brighton) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him. Brighton get a corner.
56' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
54' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simon Hooper no option but to blow his whistle. Brighton get a free kick.
51' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Burnley have a free kick.
49' Simon Adingra (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' A clumsy foul by Simon Adingra (Brighton) and Simon Hooper blows his whistle. Burnley are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
47' Sander Berge (Burnley) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
47' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Brighton.
46' Substitution. Charlie Taylor (Burnley) on for Vitinho.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Looks like Maxime Esteve (Burnley) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45+3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Burnley.
45+3' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
45+3' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
45+1' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Burnley).
43' Brighton fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Burnley) leaps to collect the ball.

43' Jakub Moder (Brighton) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the top left corner, but Arijanet Muric makes a nice save. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
42' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lorenz Assignon (Burnley). Brighton will take a free kick.

41' Joao Pedro (Brighton) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
39' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) brings his opponent down. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

36' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Arijanet Muric thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
35' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' Josh Cullen (Burnley) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
32' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is able to continue to play.
32' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
30' The game is interrupted now, Joao Pedro (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' The linesman signals that Joao Pedro (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

29' Simon Adingra (Brighton) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
28' The foul by Josh Cullen (Burnley) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simon Hooper.
24' Simon Adingra (Brighton) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Arijanet Muric.

22' Igor (Brighton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Burnley, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton win a free kick.
20' Pascal Gross (Brighton) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
19' The game is interrupted as Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is flagged offside.
19' It looks like David Datro Fofana (Burnley) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.

18' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
17' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Carlos Baleba (Brighton). Burnley will take a free kick near the side line.
16' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

15' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simon Hooper blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Brighton have been awarded a free kick.
15' Jakub Moder (Brighton) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Jakub Moder (Brighton) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
13' Pervis Estupinan is substituted due to injury. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Igor (Brighton).
11' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Half-chance! Lyle Foster (Burnley) plays a pass into the box, but Bart Verbruggen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vitinho (Burnley).
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Simon Adingra (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
4' Burnley work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

4' The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

4' Joel Veltman (Brighton) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
3' Lyle Foster (Burnley) makes a strong challenge and Simon Hooper blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brighton.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Simon Hooper got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
